name: Seattle
source_info: The values are in meters relative to the MSL. Values are the Year, Month, Relative Sea Level, Relative Sea Level minus Average Seasonal Cycle, Trend Line, Upper 95% Confidence Interval, and Lower 95% Confidence Interval. The station's single trend was used for calculation.

monthly.info: The values are in meters relative to the MSL. Values are the Year, Month, Relative Sea Level, Relative Sea Level minus Average Seasonal Cycle, Trend Line, Upper 95% Confidence Interval, and Lower 95% Confidence Interval. The station's monthly MSL data is provided for the period of record and the trend information is available starting in July 1992.
